5698.title: Background audio capability absent from iOS configuration
5698.rootCauseOneLine: Both clean main checkouts generate an iOS Info.plist without the audio background mode; the reported native mute event remains unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: Adds the missing native capability; real-device capture behavior was not tested.
Same configuration candidate; native background behavior remains unverified.

5698.proposedFix: Compare physical-iPhone recordings before and after a background-audio capability change while preserving notification support; review background-capture privacy and interruption behavior.
5698.caveats: Verified means the partial configuration finding repeated in a second clean trusted checkout. No iOS device or simulator was available; no runtime behavioral regression test or automated fix PR was created.
